summary: Frontend-only end-to-end validation of the Bhumika & Arpit engagement invitation site. All 14 required checks pass: page loads cleanly, all 5 acts render with correct data-testids, hero-title reveals, audio toggle visible/clickable with icon swap, /audio/ambient.mp3 returns 200, skip-to-details scrolls to parchment and disappears past 60% scroll, dove is fixed-positioned and animates via GSAP ScrollTrigger, parchment contains all required names/dates/venue, ripple class appears on river click, View Location + Add to Calendar hrefs are correct (google.com/calendar/render with Bhumika and 20260510), fonts resolve to Cormorant Garamond and Tenor Sans, no horizontal overflow on 1440px or 390px viewports, no runtime JS/pageerrors.

issues: After tapping Skip-to-Details, the fixed dove SVG lands on top of the 'Arpit Patel' name in the parchment, momentarily occluding it until the user scrolls further. Consider reducing dove opacity when parchment enters viewport, or shifting the dove path off the card area in Act 4.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Reduce dove z-index/opacity or reposition its Act-4 keyframe so it does not cover the groom's name on mobile parchment view after Skip-to-Details.
critical_code_review_comments: Lenis + window scroll listener: the 60%-scroll SkipButton hide uses window.scrollY against document.body.scrollHeight. With Lenis smoothWheel this still works because Lenis drives window scroll, but if Lenis mode changes to wrapper-based, this needs revisiting.
AudioToggle catches autoplay errors silently and keeps muted — good, but no user-visible feedback if playback fails. A subtle toast on failure would improve UX.
Invitation.jsx is ~560 lines; acceptable for now but could be split into per-Act components if the file grows further.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure frontend engagement site. Tested at https://forest-engagement.preview.emergentagent.com on desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844. All data-testids present: hero-title, audio-toggle, skip-to-details, dove-element, act-1-forest, act-2-messenger, act-3-journey-river, act-3-journey-temple, act-4-reveal, act-5-ending, parchment-card, cta-view-location, cta-add-calendar. Ripple CSS class appears on river-section click. Audio file /audio/ambient.mp3 returns 200. Calendar href encodes Bhumika and 20260510T093000Z/20260510T163000Z correctly. Only visual nit: dove overlays groom name on mobile when Skip-to-Details jumps user to Act 4.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA — implementation matches spec.
